checked_objectives: at least 20 positive rows in four of six fixed 30-day bins
maximum subject, unit and temporal-bin concentration
at least 80 positive rows in each arm and at least 8 units in each arm
per-family matched hard target-0 row, subject and unit objectives
near-boundary target-0 row and unit objectives
verification: The support assessor reads post-generation aggregate audit records in memory and has no sampling, filtering, label override or retry interface. Hand-built abstract records exercised PASS, empty/fail, low-row, subject concentration, cluster, unit, temporal and arm failures. These records are not transactions and are not used to estimate support.
family_specific_results: No empirical support measurements exist for the challenge population.
failed_objective_policy: Retain the single completed draw and publish only the predeclared aggregate certificate; no regeneration or threshold relaxation.
